prs.title: feat: celebrate donations before campaign parties
prs.body:
## Summary
Celebrate donations and campaign fundraising in Stream Avatars.
## Release notes
- Connect the bot to Stream Avatars for shared donation celebrations.
- Show hearts, donation amounts, and jumps or hugs before confetti and dancing for campaign milestones and fundraising goals.
- Test donation celebrations locally with the integration runner.
## Upgrade actions
- Import the latest companion package and restore private address/token settings after reimporting.
## Validation
- npm test: passed.
